# @trysac/security-headers-check

> Check HTTP response headers against OWASP Secure Headers guidance: HSTS grammar per RFC 6797, CSP presence, framing, nosniff, referrer, cookies and version leaks, with stable rule IDs TypeScript library for Node.js 20+, published as ES modules with type declarations. MIT.
